review_text: I zoomed past this place as I was rushing down Catalunan Grande Road. Had to turn back as I was also looking for a coffee fix somewhere there earlier. During the day I can't complain it's quiet. As I liked both drinks it's highly probable I'll be back soon.
Nice café with great food and good milk tea. They also have free Wi-Fi, which is perfect if you want to study or work. Cozy place to hang out and relax. Will definitely come back.
Your food is super delicious, I will definitely come back here next time ❤️
